issues.problem: Warm start is path dependent: its risks (forgetting, error persistence) accumulate over consecutive updates. Sampling 10-15 isolated origin days tests only single-step warm starts from a fresh checkpoint, hides exactly the failure modes the answer lists, and makes the 'day-to-day stability' and 'injected bad batch recovery' checks impossible. The warm-start chain is cheap (about 40 min per day), only the full-retrain baseline needs sampling.
issues.replacement: so run the warm-start chain on consecutive days from one full-retrain checkpoint, since it is cheap at about 40 minutes a day and its errors accumulate along the chain, and compute the full-retrain baseline only on a sample of 10 to 15 of those days or on a subsampled dataset)
